name: farmhand
description: Family homestead farming game for a shared tablet, plus a parent admin panel.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @farmhand/shared && npm run build -w @farmhand/api && npm run build -w @farmhand/player && npm run build -w @farmhand/admin && npm run build -w @farmhand/parent
scripts.test: npm run test -w @farmhand/shared && npm run test -w @farmhand/api && npm run test -w @farmhand/player
